<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Character at cols 54-63 (merged with right edge). Move LEFT to get back.
# Each LEFT moves 3 columns. Need to move LEFT to get character away from right edge.
# Let's move LEFT 5 (5*3=15 columns), from cols 54-63 to cols 39-48.
result = action(['LEFT'] * 5)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['B', 'c', 'Y'] and n['pixels'] > 10:
        print(f"  id={n['id']} color={n['color']} pixels={n['pixels']} boundary={n['boundary']}")
print("Level completed:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
print("Gameplay changed:", last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
